description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants. Unified access to frontier LLMs

Open-source super AI assistant & Agent Harness. Plans tasks, runs tools and skills, self-evolves with memory and knowledge. Multi-agent, multi-model, multi-channel. Lightweight, extensible, one-line install. (formerly chatgpt-on-wechat)
An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.

Local-first cross-platform desktop workspace for Claude Code / agents: multi-agent, Git worktrees, code diffs, skill marketplace, multi-model, Computer Use, task-aware desktop pets, with WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, WhatsApp and H5 access.

Omnigent is an open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents — swap harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device.
A general-purpose AIGC video engine: script to finished film in one pipeline — dramas, ads, product videos, otome games, and more. | 通用 AIGC 视频引擎 —— 从剧本到成片一条流水线，漫剧、广告、电商、乙游皆可
Okou connects to the tools your team already uses and does the work — across marketing, sales, engineering, and operations, under your control.

pi had nothing (nothing), so I made something (something) — sorry mariozechner-senpai, I went ahead and lovingly soiled your pure pi for you. opinionated fork of badlogic/pi-mono with extension-first additions. ganbare ganbare senpi 頑張れ頑張れ先輩
Local-first, governed AI agent runtime for Python — embed it in your app, or run it as a CLI or ACP server. Permissions, MCP, memory and audit replay built in.

Hire a private AI tutor for anything — it reads how you actually learn and teaches the next lesson just for you. Bloom's 2-Sigma research as a Claude Code skill + self-hostable web app · 中文优先 苏格拉底式 AI 家教

Open-source 3D AI agent framework — GLB/glTF avatars with LLM brains, memory, emotions, and autonomous payments. MCP server · x402 · Solana/EVM · Three.js. Embed anywhere as a web component. Character studio, animation gallery, OAuth 2.1. Browser-native.

PawWork — free, open-source desktop AI agent for macOS and Windows, built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free models included, no API key or terminal. Office files, web search, and scheduled automations out of the box. An open alternative to Codex App and Claude Cowork.
A coding agent: give it a prompt and it reads, writes, runs commands, and searches code in a loop until the work is done, using native tool-calling across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models.

Open-source, single-binary, self-hosted AI agent — your models and data stay on your machine. A coding agent on par with Claude Code and a personal assistant lighter than OpenClaw, across eight interfaces (TUI, CLI, Web, desktop, IM, VS Code, Obsidian, Mobile), all in one MIT-licensed Go binary running on any model.
